turns.question: Who was our best customer in September 2026, and how much did they spend?
turns.answer: By revenue (the sum of non-cancelled order amounts), the top customer from 1 to 30 September 2026 was customer 3, with 1,380.00 EUR (the semantic layer identifies customers only by ID, not by name; next was customer 10 at 1,376.25 EUR). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
